description: This file defines a Perl module Git::IndexInfo that manages index information for a Git repository, including creating new entries, removing, updating, and handling resources.

classes.name: Git::IndexInfo
classes.description: A class that encapsulates index information, providing methods to manage Git index entries.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new Git::IndexInfo object, setting up the index pipe and configuration.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an index entry for a given path from the index, writing a record to the index pipe.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Adds or updates an index entry with mode, hash, and path, writing the information to the index pipe.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor that closes the index pipe and cleans up resources.
